A '''proximity shield''' was a type of short-range shielding used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to confine their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Prisoner/Legends|captives]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] was once detained behind a proximity shield during a mission on Dathomir.

==History and usage==
On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], proximity shields were used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], a society of all-[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darksiders]], to contain their [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in compounds. It would both stop the "[[maleling]]s" from escaping and protect them against rival clans on a man raid after breeders. When activated, a proximity shield emitted an [[Color/Legends|orange]] energectic barrier that was strong enough to hurt a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] trying to get through it.<ref name="IE1" />

Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]], self-proclaimed "[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the Nightsisters", made wide use of these shields to contain her slaves on the work camps. The same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] was captured during his mission on Dathomir and kept behind one such device for a time. Amongst the prisoners were also an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], two [[Duro/Legends|Duros]] and [[Yag Shushin]], a [[Givin/Legends|Givin]].<ref name="IE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The proximity shields appeared in [[Star Wars (1998) 23|the twenty-third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' series of comics, published on [[October 25]], [[2000]].<ref name="IE1" />
